operations.migration_plan: Keep the scope through the PKCE soak because browser-side ChangePassword still needs the access-token scope. Move password change behind a backend proxy, deploy, soak for at least the 30-day refresh-token lifetime, then set P07_AUTH_MIGRATION_PHASE to cutover_complete and remove this scope with implicit grant.

The OPTIONAL-MFA grace UI associates a software token for the signed-in user. Before public-client scope removal, move enrollment behind an approved auth service flow that does not require the SPA client to request COGNITO_ADMIN.

The live settings flow calls Cognito ChangePassword directly. Add a Handler -> Logic -> DAL backend proxy, cut the settings page to that proxy, and verify it in production before COGNITO_ADMIN is removed from the public client.

The settings-page enrollment grace verifies TOTP and sets the preferred MFA factor. Preserve COGNITO_ADMIN until enrollment is migrated behind an approved auth service flow and the deployed migration has soaked.
